new_material_candidates.name: AdaMEM
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides a concrete language-agent test-time adaptation mechanism based on persistent trajectory memory and dynamically synthesized short-term strategy memory.

new_material_candidates.name: Stochastic Encodings for Active Feature Acquisition
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Directly models sequential decisions about which feature to measure next, making it closely aligned with investigation or measurement-value comparison roles.

new_material_candidates.name: Explainability-Driven Active Feature Acquisition
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Uses instance-specific explanations and a decision-transformer policy to sequentially choose which feature to acquire next.

new_material_candidates.name: Dynamic Logits Adjustment and Exploration
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Adds class-wise logit adjustment and exploratory cache selection to VLM adaptation, a materially distinct 2026 mechanism found in the bounded E3 spot-check.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator / Learning to Extrapolate to New Tasks
n_h2_reference_research.verified_relevance: Learns relational transformations between tasks and composes them when extrapolating to unseen tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The demonstrated task-extrapolation setting does not establish one learned decision mechanism transferring across Hetren's agent, structured-ML, and vision environment families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.verified_relevance: Meta-learns active feature acquisition across structured-data tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The transfer scope remains active feature acquisition in structured/tabular task families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: SAGE
n_h2_reference_research.verified_relevance: Accumulates and reuses learned skills across chains of related agent tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Published evidence does not demonstrate the same decision policy transferred across E1, E2, and E3.
